info.name: GitHub Re-run Job from Workflow Run

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: job_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the job.

items.docs:
Re-run a job and its dependent jobs in a workflow run.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: run_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run.

items.docs:
Re-runs your workflow run using its `id`.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

info.name: GitHub Re-run Failed Jobs from Workflow Run

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: run_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the workflow run.

items.docs:
Re-run all of the failed jobs and their dependent jobs in a workflow run using the `id` of the workflow run.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
